The duties and responsibilities for a IT Project Manager (NETWORK/INFOSEC) GS-2210-13 generally include, but are not limited to, the following: Monitor infrastructure performance, availability, reliability, resiliency, operational readiness, and service dependencies; resolve complex operational issues.

Coordinate with budget, acquisition, contracting, program, and technical personnel to ensure effective management of IT resources. Develop network project plans, technical requirements, implementation strategies, schedules, milestones, and resource requirements.

Provide technical recommendations to contracting officials regarding contract administration, modifications, deliverable acceptance, schedule changes, and performance issues. Lead cross-functional teams of technical staff, program officials, contractors, vendors, and internal/external stakeholders.
To qualify for the position of IT Project Manager (NETWORK/INFOSEC), at GS-2210-13, you must meet the basic qualification requirements listed below. Basic Qualifications (2210 series): Please refer to the OPM IT Management Series 2210 Qualification Standard for the specific experience requirements for the GS-12 and above positions.

AND Specialized Experience: To qualify for the GS-13 grade level, you must have one (1) year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the GS-12 grade level in the Federal service, or comparable non-Federal experience.

Specialized experience is defined as experience performing the following duties: Participate in the planning execution and monitoring enterprise IT projects involving network services, information security, and/or telecommunications. You MUST meet all qualification requirements by the 09/04/2026 of this announcement.

Your resume must support your responses to the application questionnaire and the qualification requirements. Failure to do so may result in an ineligible rating. See the Required Documents section for important notes about what must be included in your resume.

After you submit this application, you will receive an e-mail informing you that a USA Hire assessment is required of you. You will have 48 hours from the closing date of this announcement 09/04/2026 to complete the assessment as this assessment is part of your application.

As an IT Project Manager/Scrum Master, you will: Lead multifaceted Information Technology (IT) software and infrastructure projects using waterfall, hybrid or agile delivery methods for the Railroad Retirement Board.

Work across functional and organizational lines and deal with the full range of issues and concerns associated with IT systems within the agency. Manage project resources, including overseeing contractors and mentoring IT and business teams.

Develop and implement plans, providing cost-benefit analysis, designing and conducting analytical studies, managing resources, and defining objectives and risks. Develop information systems testing strategies, identifying standards for infrastructure configuration, and developing information security plans and procedures.

Serve as an Agile scrum master for application development projects by developing and executing user/epic stories, roadmap, product backlog, sprints, Kanban tracking, retrospectives, etc.
Selective Placement Factor: This position includes a job-related knowledge, skill, and/or ability that is required for satisfactory performance for the position. Selective placement factors are a prerequisite to appointment and represents minimum requirements for a position. Application materials must demonstrate the selective placement factor.

Applicants who do not meet it are ineligible for further consideration. The Selective Placement Factor for this position is: Certification as a Project Management Professional (PMP) from the Project Management Institute.

(Project Management Professional (PMP)® Certification | PMI) In addition to meeting the selective placement factor above, to qualify for this position you must also meet the qualification requirements listed below. For Grade GS-14: Applicants must have IT-related experience demonstrating each of the four competencies listed below.

Applicants must demonstrate possession of these competencies within the body of the resume; no separate statements addressing them are required. Attention to Detail - Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail.

Customer Service - Works with clients and customers (that is, any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services.

Oral Communication - Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately.

Problem Solving - Identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations. -AND- One year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-13 grade level in the Federal service.

Specialized Experience is experience that has equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities/competencies to perform successfully the duties of the position and is typically in or related to the work of the position to be filled.

Specialized experience is defined as demonstrated experience: Leading complex software and infrastructure IT projects using waterfall, hybrid, and Agile methodology. Developing IT project plans that incorporate risk controls, testing/training needs, acceptance criteria, change management, and IT governance.

Executing IT project work by monitoring technical progress, updating activities in tracking tools, resolving system-related impediments, and ensuring all required IT deliverables are completed accurately and on schedule.

Planning and leading scrum ceremonies such as standups meetings, backlog grooming, sprint planning, sprint review (demonstrations), release planning, and sprint retrospectives. Leading project teams and contractors by coaching, establishing goals, monitoring performance, and providing constructive feedback.

Managing stakeholder expectations by gathering input, resolving issues, and communicating project status to ensure transparency. Only experience obtained by the closing date of this announcement will be considered.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience. Documenting experience: IN DESCRIBING YOUR EXPERIENCE, PLEASE BE CLEAR AND SPECIFIC.

WE WILL NOT MAKE ASSUMPTIONS REGARDING YOUR EXPERIENCE. Qualifications are based on breadth/level of experience. In addition to describing duties performed, applicants must provide the exact dates of each period of employment (from MM/YY to MM/YY) and the number of hours worked per week if part time.

As qualification determinations cannot be made when resumes do not include the required information, failure to provide this information may result in disqualification. Applicants are encouraged to use the USAJOBS Resume Builder to develop their federal resume.

Do not copy and paste the duties or specialized experience from this announcement into your resume as that will not be considered a demonstration of your qualifications for this position.

The position serves as a Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) Program Manager and specialist for all BARD patron-facing products in the Patron Engagement Section (PES), Patron and Network Engagement Division, National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS), Library Collections and Services Group.

As the Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) Program Manager and specialist, you will: Serve as the subject matter expert in the development, implementation, and distribution of all versions of the product.

Review and analyze all BARD patron-facing products to ensure continuity in operation, consistency in delivery, high-level of accessibility, and that all patron considerations have been met. Coordinate all patron-facing customer service and technical support for all BARD products.

This includes BARD on the web, BARD Mobile for iOS, BARD Mobile for Android, BARD Mobile for Fire Devices, BARD Express, Digital Advanced (DA2) Talking Book machine, and the My Talking Book Skill. Serve as the primary liaison between the various BARD initiatives, NLS patrons, and other NLS stakeholders. Perform other duties as assigned.

The position description number for this position is 467973. The salary range indicated reflects the locality pay adjustments for the Washington, D.C., Metropolitan area. The incumbent of this position will work a Flexitime work schedule. This is a non-supervisory, non-bargaining unit position.

The United States Space Force (USSF) at Buckley Space Force Base, Colorado is searching for a Resource Adviser & Program Manager to support the 11 SWS (NH-0301-02, GS 05-11 equivalent). Description: Administrative Management): Directly assists the commander/director in the management of all administrative support program functions.

Administers programs and serves as the primary source of information. The incumbent is responsible for the preparation, maintenance, and deposition of required administrative reports and other correspondence.

Assists commander/director in accomplishing all necessary internal operations to include administrative training, security, development of organizational operating instructions and regulations, and personnel assistance.

Acts as the point of contact for all newly assigned personnel; orients them regarding the basic functions of the organization, introduces them to key personnel and schedules their initial training/orientation requirements Program Compliance & Management): Serves as the resident subject matter expert for all mandated administrative support programs.

Ensures unit program compliance with regulations, laws, policies, and squadron commander directives.

Responsible for programs to include but not limited to task management, cybersecurity liaison (CL), Government Travel Card (GTC) program, Unit Deployment Manager (UDM), Defense Travel System (DTS) administrator, drug demand reduction program, health care program, fitness program, Government Purchase Card (GPC) program, safety program, Automated Data Processing Equipment (ADPE) accounts, security program, supply program, civilian timecard program and unit recognition program.

Develops and implements procedures to track program status and maintain program health. Serves as the organizational point of contact and liaison with the personnel flight on military and civilian personnel issues.

Stays abreast of current personnel issues and provides explanations of personnel-related requirements, regulations, and procedures to supervisors and managers. Determines the necessary steps to perform the full range of administrative functions associated with personnel assignments, promotions, and performance evaluations.

Generates and processes required military and civilian personnel transactions. Monitors military personnel action requests, tracks personnel, manpower, and training transactions as documentation flows through the office and provides status reports to management.

Monitors preparation of performance reports, reviews for accuracy and consistency with available guidelines, and ensures timely submission. Coordinates work efforts affecting organizational personnel with appropriate offices and resolves conflicts. Assists in planning, administering, and monitoring manpower resource requirements.

Serves as the point of contact for both civilian and military position utilization. Maintains manpower manning documents. Reviews requests for revised manpower authorizations, and makes recommendations for approval or disapproval as required. Receives changes to UMD and notifies appropriate officials and follows up with appropriate action.

Provides guidance to supervisors relating to military and civilian manpower requirements, organizational structure, authorization and utilization of positions, military civilian mix, skills imbalance. Reviews requests for military and civilian fills. Reviews requests for civilian over hires. Reviews all projected movements of authorizations.

Performs other clerical and administrative work in support of the office/organization. Develops, establishes, updates, and maintains office procedures and records/files of various types to ensure effective and efficient operation of the office.

Provides advice and guidance to staff in the organization on administrative, clerical, and procedural requirements. Assists other clerical staff in locating and selecting the appropriate guidelines, references, and procedures for application to specific cases. Updates tracker or suspense files for unclassified documents as required.

In accordance with established procedures prepares, consolidates, submits, and maintains time and attendance. Assists project officer in making arrangements for command sponsored events ensuring proper protocol is followed. Advises the installation commander on all budgetary, financial, and resource management matters.

Executes the commander's vision on resource allocation in support of mission and installation operations, maintenance, and sustainment. Performs budget formulation work, including the preparation of detailed analyses of annual and/or multi-year budget estimates for assigned organizations/programs into a consolidated budget request.

Assembles and/or develops background data, information, and documentation to support required program budgets.
The 0301 series does not have an individual occupational requirement that must be met. You can view the experience level requirements here. Please scroll down to the 3rd section titled Administrative and Management Positions.

CodeWrights entwickelt individuelle Softwarelösungen für einige der weltweit führenden Industrieunternehmen. Als Spezialist für industrielle Software, Geräteintegration und digitale Produktentwicklung unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, komplexe technische Herausforderungen erfolgreich zu lösen.
Du sorgst dafür, dass anspruchsvolle Software- und Entwicklungsprojekte zielgerichtet, transparent und verlässlich durch die Organisation geführt werden. Dabei koordinierst du Anforderungen, Ressourcen, Termine, Risiken und die Kommunikation zwischen allen Beteiligten und stellst sicher, dass Teams effizient zusammenarbeiten und gemeinsam optimale Lösungen für unsere Kunden entwickeln.
In deiner Rolle bist du weit mehr als klassischer PM: Du navigierst durch komplexe technische und organisatorische Zusammenhänge, moderierst Entscheidungen, schaffst Transparenz und verbindest Kunden, Entwicklungsteams und Stakeholder zu einem leistungsfähigen Projektumfeld. Dabei behältst du sowohl die Kundenanforderungen als auch wirtschaftliche Ziele und die Dynamik im Team im Blick.
Wir sind eine Expertenorganisation mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, hoher Eigenverantwortung und einem modernen Dynamic-Work-Ansatz. Zusammenarbeit, Transparenz und Verantwortung dort, wo die Kompetenz liegt, prägen unsere Arbeitsweise.
Die Tür steht dir offen, wenn du Mut, Disziplin und die Fähigkeit mitbringst, anspruchsvolle Projekte erfolgreich zum Abschluss zu führen. Du verfügst über fundiertes technisches Verständnis und Projektmanagement-Erfahrung und gehst Themen nicht nur organisatorisch, sondern auch fachlich in der Tiefe an.

Idealerweise hast du einen Hintergrund in der Softwareentwicklung, Elektrotechnik oder einem ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Umfeld und dich gezielt in Richtung Projektmanagement weiterentwickelt. Mit deiner starken Kommunikationsfähigkeit verbindest du Menschen, schaffst Vertrauen und führst Projekte erfolgreich zum Ziel.
Die Position ist an unserem Standort in Karlsruhe angesiedelt.
Aufgaben

s.h: Ganz konkret erwarten Dich unter anderem folgende Aufgaben
s.t:
Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Software- und Entwicklungsprojekte und führst diese hinsichtlich Zielerreichung, Qualität, Termin, Budget und Risiko zum Erfolg.
Du schaffst Transparenz über Anforderungen, Scope, Prioritäten, Abhängigkeiten und Entscheidungsbedarfe und sorgst für eine verlässliche Projektsteuerung.
Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für Kunden, Entwicklungsteams und interne Stakeholder und steuerst die Zusammenarbeit über alle Projektphasen hinweg.
Du koordinierst mehrere Projekte parallel, balancierst Ressourcen, Prioritäten und Kundenanforderungen und behältst dabei stets die wirtschaftlichen Ziele im Blick.
Du erkennst Risiken, Zielkonflikte und Änderungsbedarfe frühzeitig, triffst fundierte Entscheidungen und leitest geeignete Maßnahmen zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung ein.
Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf, verantwortest Projektcontrolling und Forecasts und bringst deine Erfahrungen zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung unserer Projektmanagement-Methoden ein.

Du hast bereits erfolgreich mehrere Projekte und unterschiedliche Stakeholder gleichzeitig gesteuert und behältst auch bei hoher Komplexität den Überblick.
Du überzeugst durch Mut, Disziplin und ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung und triffst auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen fundierte Entscheidungen.
Du kommunizierst klar, verbindlich und auf Augenhöhe mit Kunden, Entwicklungsteams und Management und schaffst es, unterschiedliche Interessen zusammenzuführen.
Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

At Novakid, we are on a mission to build the world’s best online education platform for children. With over 100,000 students and 4,000 teachers, Novakid is already one of the most popular language learning platforms for children aged 4–12 across Europe and Asia.

About the role We are building a new interactive entertainment project for families (parents + children) — with YouTube as the main platform and content home.

Short-form content (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) will serve as the acquisition engine: hooks, teasers, cliffhangers, and emotional moments designed to drive viewers to the main YouTube episodes.

You will own the creative direction for both long-form and short-form — ensuring every piece of content works together as a system, not separately. Before we invest in full production, we will first test concepts using short-form content to measure audience demand, engagement, and intent to watch longer episodes.

Cultural & Audience Insight Ensure concepts resonate with parents culturally and emotionally, with a focus on the TR market Anticipate cross-cultural interpretation, humor, and sensitivity Keep Novakid relevant to real parent conversations, not marketing narratives What you have done before (real experience we need) You have concepted and led production of long-form YouTube content (8–20+ min) — episodic, story-driven, with clear hooks and payoff.

You have successfully repurposed long-form content into short-form trailers/teasers that drove measurable traffic back to YouTube. You have tested content concepts using only short-form (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) before investing in full episodes — and can show examples of how you made that decision.

You understand YouTube organic metrics (CTR, retention, AVD) and short-form metrics (completion rate, shares, comments) — and how they relate. You have worked on projects with participatory or community elements (even simple ones like comments shaping next steps). Key responsibilities YouTube first: Everything starts with the long-form episode.

Short-form serves it, not the other way around. Test fast: Use short-form to validate concepts before building full episodes. Own the creative vision from title/thumbnail to final frame of each episode. Collaborate with production teams but stay responsible for viral instincts and audience psychology.

Analyze performance across both formats and iterate quickly. Requirements Must-have qualifications Portfolio with long-form YouTube content you concepted (show retention, CTR, or growth if possible). Proven ability to drive traffic from short-form to long-form (examples required).

Deep understanding of TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts as acquisition tools, not standalone entertainment. Obsessed with hooks, pacing, cliffhangers, and payoff. Strong interest in parenting, family dynamics, or human stories involving children Requirements: Experience leading video projects from concept to final delivery.

Experience with family, parenting, or kids content. Basic editing or thumbnail design sense. Experience building a YouTube channel (other Social Media channels) from zero. C1 level English We offer: Opportunity to work in an innovative, fast-growing edtech company. A creative and collaborative work environment.

Comprehensive professional development and leadership growth opportunities. The chance to have a meaningful impact on the lives of young learners around the world. 100% Remote work Unlimited holidays Bonuses and stock options Highlights Originally posted on Himalayas

You will be the principal authority for the planning phase of all repair, alteration, and modernization work to the area Regional Maintenance Center (RMC) on assigned ship(s) during availabilities and a core member of the ships maintenance team.
You will assure planning estimates are established for timely receipt of funds.
You will resolve problems affecting the end cost, quality, schedule, and performance of contracts.
You will establish and maintain effective liaison relationships with Systems Commands, Type Commanders, Warfare Centers, and other customer representatives.
You will evaluate and analyze applicable policies and procedures and recommend changes to improve work processes utilizing manpower and material resources more effectively geared towards the overall project accomplishment.
You will coordinate, schedule, and administer assigned repair work to ensure that advanced planning functions are completed in time to permit orderly work list preparation, screening, specification preparations, and material ordering.
You will coordinate, edit, correlate, and perform quality audits of work specification packages to ensure authorized work is accomplished as agreed upon with customers.
You will develop new approaches, modify processes/techniques, and provide materials for guides/standards to be used by engineers, technicians, and others comprised of public and private resources to effect ship modernization, overhauls, and repair.
Your resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-12 grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector.

Specialized experience must demonstrate the following: Planning and managing ship overhaul operations by evaluating production activities and estimating labor or material costs in order to develop and implement improvements for fleet modernization efforts.

Major Duties include: Conducts concurrent and retrospective analysis and auditing of medical records, reporting results and recommending follow up actions. Performs investigations, audits, and fact finding on behalf of senior leadership, OIG, OSC, OMI, and Congressional inquiries.

Evaluates and directs the performance of facility business operations, using analysis to identify issues and recommend corrective action. Is a subject matter expert on industry standards such as CMS OPPS/IPPS, DRG, AN98, and non government healthcare billing/collections requirements.

Applies analytical, evaluative, developmental, and advisory skills toward recommending improvements in policy, procedures, and structure. Communicates and educates veterans, veteran organizations, and community groups regarding Business Office functions and regulatory changes.

Interacts with staff and supervisors across facilities to ensure complete and accurate capture of patient insurance information. Prepares briefing materials and maintains up to date technical familiarity when engaging with high level officials and stakeholders.

Justifies, explains, and settles controversial matters with high ranking members of Congress, VA leadership, and external stakeholders. Provides leadership in all areas of patient administration, including admissions, entitlement, scheduling, Community Care, and transcription.

Develops performance measures for supervisors and subordinate units, guiding their improvement and direction. Leads major organizational change, revising long range plans, goals, objectives, and adapting structure based on legislative or operational changes.

Consults with SES level VISN and facility leadership to make decisions on complex issues affecting 128 sites of care, demonstrating executive level leadership. Maintains expert knowledge of VHA policies across Revenue Operations, Eligibility, Enrollment, Community Care, Medical Records, Coding, HIM, Consult Management, Scheduling, etc.

Oversees implementation of new policies and programs approved by headquarters for all Business Office functions. Reviews and approves the substance of facility responses to OIG, OSC, OMI, and Secretary level inquiries to ensure accurate reflection of policy and organizational positions.

Position Description/PD#: VISN Business Implementation Manager-Temporary NTE 1 year/PD117480 Relocation/Recruitment Incentives: Not Authorized Permanent Change of Station (PCS): Not Authorized
To qualify for this position, applicants must meet all requirements by the closing date of this announcement, 08/05/2026. Time-In-Grade Requirement: Applicants who are current Federal employees and have held a GS grade any time in the past 52 weeks must also meet time-in-grade requirements by the closing date of this announcement.

For a GS-15 position you must have served 52 weeks at the GS-14. The grade may have been in any occupation, but must have been held in the Federal service. An SF-50 that shows your time-in-grade eligibility must be submitted with your application materials.

If the most recent SF-50 has an effective date within the past year, it may not clearly demonstrate you possess one-year time-in-grade, as required by the announcement. In this instance, you must provide an additional SF-50 that clearly demonstrates one-year time-in-grade.

Note: Time-In-Grade requirements also apply to former Federal employees applying for reinstatement as well as current employees applying for Veterans Employment Opportunities Act of 1998 (VEOA) appointment.

You may qualify based on your experience as described below: Specialized Experience: You must have one year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade GS-14 in the normal line of progression for the occupation in the organization.

Examples of specialized experience would typically include, but are not limited to: extensive experience overseeing large-scale healthcare business operations; leading large, diverse, geographically dispersed teams, including senior managers, supervisors, and multi-disciplinary operational staff; conducting high-risk audits, investigations, and fact-finding activities, and producing recommendations that impact enterprise policy and operations; extensive experience in technical health administration functions, federal billing systems, regulatory standards, and specialized programs required to lead VISN wide operations; communicating clear, authoritative and persuasive information to high-ranking officials, internal stakeholders, external agencies, and the public; creating, implementing, and maintaining policies, strategic plans, and long range operational designs across a large system.

Preferred Experience: Highly desirable candidates are encouraged to possess a Master of Business Administration (MBA), a Master of Health Administration (MHA), a Baccalaureate (Bachelor's) degree in Business or Health, or three to five years of progressively responsible experience in Business Office operations within Health Care.

These qualifications strongly align with the competency level for successful performance in this role and will be given consideration in the evaluation process, though they are not required to qualify.

For more information on these qualification standards, please visit the United States Office of Personnel Management's website at https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/.

The Project Manager serves as the operational leader for curriculum and ancillary product development within Ascension 's Schools Team. Working closely with the Associate General Manager, Product Managers, Curriculum Specialists, Editorial, Design, Video, Marketing, and Sales, this role manages the planning, coordination, execution, and tracking of projects from concept through launch.
The Project Manager develops and maintains project schedules, coordinates cross-functional teams, manages resources and timelines, identifies risks, and ensures deliverables remain on schedule and within scope. This role is responsible for creating efficient project management systems that enable the successful development of K–12 curriculum, teacher resources, digital products, videos, and ancillary materials while supporting the mission of providing exceptional Catholic educational resources.

Team Project Management
Own and maintain the School's Team master production calendar, coordinating curriculum development across multiple grades, ancillary products, digital resources, video production, editorial, design, and product launches to ensure alignment with strategic priorities and release schedules.
Project Planning & Execution
Develop comprehensive project plans, timelines, milestones, and resource allocations for curriculum and ancillary product development.
Manage multiple concurrent curriculum projects across K–12 and supporting product lines.
Coordinate project schedules across internal and external teams.
Monitor project progress and proactively identify schedule risks, resource constraints, and dependencies.
Facilitate timely decision-making by escalating issues and recommending solutions when necessary.
Ensure projects remain on schedule, within scope, and aligned with organizational priorities.
Cross-Functional Coordination
Serve as a central communication hub for project teams and stakeholders.
Coordinate project meetings, agendas, follow-up items, and action plans.
Maintain clear communication regarding project status, milestones, risks, and upcoming deadlines.
Work closely with Product Managers to translate product vision into executable project plans.
Coordinate the work of internal and external teams throughout the product lifecycle.
Resource & Workflow Management
Develop and maintain long-range production schedules across multiple curriculum programs and grade levels.
Coordinate internal and external resources to maximize efficiency and balance workloads.
Maintain project management systems, dashboards, and documentation.
Monitor project capacity and recommend resource adjustments to meet organizational priorities.
Support contractor onboarding and scheduling as needed.
Manage contract requests and implementations with external contractors and vendors, as needed.
Product Documentation & Quality
Develop and maintain project documentation, including schedules, workflows, product specifications, meeting notes, and checklists.
Coordinate quality assurance checkpoints throughout curriculum development.
Ensure project documentation is accurate, organized, and accessible to stakeholders.
Support smooth transitions between curriculum development, editorial, production, and product launch.
Reporting
Assist Product Managers and leadership in developing processes for project budgets and production estimates.
Track project expenditures and resource utilization.
Develop project dashboards and status reports for leadership.
Collect and analyze project metrics to improve forecasting, scheduling accuracy, and team performance.
Process Improvement
Evaluate project management workflows and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, communication, and scalability.
Develop standardized templates, processes, and best practices for curriculum development projects.
Support the implementation of new project management tools and technologies.
Promote continuous improvement across the Schools Team.

## Description de l'entreprise ##
Avec plus de 13'000 collaborateurs et collaboratrices représentant 160 métiers, les Hôpitaux Universitaires de Genève sont un établissement de référence au niveau national et international. Pour en savoir plus sur notre institution, prenez quelques minutes pour consulter notre rétrospective 2025 en cliquant ici.
La Direction des soins incarne l-autorité en matière de soins. Elle a pour mission de garantir la qualité et la sécurité des soins au sein de l'établissement. A ce titre, la Direction des soins a droit de regard sur l-ensemble des activités des soins (infirmiers, infirmières et différents corps professionnels de santé).

Pour remplir sa mission, elle s-appuie sur trois pôles d'expertises : qualité, durabilité et innovation digitale ; expertise clinique et pratiques professionnelles ; management et transformation.
## Description du poste ##
La direction des soins est à la recherche de son ou sa future responsable diététicienne pour manager et accompagner les équipes sur le site de Cluse-Roseraie dans leurs prestations dans différents départements médicaux. La patientèle peut être adulte comme pédiatrique notamment dans le domaine des soins aigus ainsi que pour l-enseignement thérapeutique au décours de la maladie chronique.
Vous dirigez une équipe d-environ 30 collaborateurs et collaboratrices. Vous organisez, coordonnez et supervisez leurs activités et prévoyez toute action nécessaire de développement des compétences individuelles comme collectives. Vous garantissez une circulation optimale des informations, qu-elle soit ascendante, descendante et/ ou transversale. Vous développez un climat de confiance dans l-équipe nécessaire au bien vivre et travailler ensemble dans le respect des valeurs institutionnelles.
Vous savez donner le cap et accompagner vos équipes pour atteindre des objectifs communs. Vous déclinez les axes stratégiques de votre métier en objectifs réalisables par l-équipe tout en veillant à la contribution individuelle de chaque membre.
En qualité de responsable d-équipe, vous êtes garante ou garant de la qualité des soins nutritionnels et promouvez toute mesure visant à optimiser et à améliorer les prestations offertes à la patientèle. Vous disposez d-indicateurs pour conduire l-amélioration continue de la qualité. Vous contribuez également au développement de nouvelles pratiques.
Votre esprit collaboratif vous permet de soutenir et développer l-interdisciplinarité entre tous les professionnelles et professionnels de la santé agissant sur la prise en charge des patientes et patients.
Vous gérez aisément la bonne allocation des ressources comme du matériel pour répondre aux besoins en soins des patients et patientes dans le cadre du budget alloué. Vous exercez également un rôle de référente ou référent pour les systèmes tarifaires en lien avec la profession
Selon les besoins, vous êtes amené ou amenée à recruter de nouvelles collaboratrices et collaborateurs et veillez au développement de leur expertise dans les champs de spécialité de chaque secteur tout en veillant à la polyvalence nécessaire des compétences

Vous êtes titulaire d'un Bachelor HES en nutrition et diététique ou d'un titre jugé équivalent, reconnu par la Croix-Rouge suisse.
Vous bénéficiez d'une expérience confirmée en management, acquise au travers d'au moins cinq années de pratique dans le domaine hospitalier. Une formation en management, telle qu'un CAS en management des institutions de santé, constitue un atout.
Dotée ou doté d'excellentes qualités relationnelles, vous faites preuve d'entregent et d'une communication positive. Vous savez fédérer les équipes autour d'objectifs communs et instaurer un climat de collaboration propice au bon fonctionnement du service.
Ouvert ou ouverte au changement, vous êtes capable d'accompagner les évolutions de votre environnement professionnel avec pragmatisme. Vous savez également prendre du recul sur vos pratiques managériales afin de les faire évoluer de manière continue.
Vous êtes une personne reconnue pour votre sens de l'organisation, votre flexibilité et votre capacité à gérer les priorités, vous êtes à l'aise dans un environnement où les activités sont variées et transversales.
Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques courants et possédez une excellente maîtrise de la langue française.

* Das Entwickeln und Steuern des Bauportfolioplans in zugeteilten verkehrlichen Achsen, den Rayons der Region Mitte, ist deine Hauptaufgabe. Du trägst massgeblich dazu bei, dass in der Region eine Gesamtsicht der laufenden und zukünftigen Projekte zur Verfügung steht.
* Du legst gemeinsam mit deinen Partnern die Rahmenbedingungen für die Bauausführung und deren Auswirkungen auf die Bahnbetriebskapazität fest. Bereits ab der Studienphase erarbeitest du Konzepte für notwendige Intervalle wie Gleissperren, Logistik und Bauverfahren und berücksichtigst dabei Kosten-Nutzen-Überlegungen sowie die Interessen des Bauprojekts und der Streckenkapazität.
* Zielkonflikte, Kapazitätsengpässe und Synergien erkennst du früh und erarbeitest Lösungsvorschläge. Schlüssel- und Ankerprojekte identifizierst und begleitest du zur Bündelung von Bauaktivitäten.
* Projektübergreifend überprüfst du frühzeitig die Bauphasen in kritischen Perimetern, um eine Gesamtsicht der netzweiten Kapazitätsauswirkungen zu erlangen. Im Konfliktfall unterstützt du die Partner bei der Erarbeitung von Lösungen, die aus Sicht des Gesamtsystems das Optimum darstellen.
* Eine abgestimmte Sicht auf das Bauportfolio stellst du sicher und bringst die Perspektive des Netzmanagements aktiv in die Planung ein.
Das bringst du mit.
* Lösungsorientierte Zusammenarbeit ist dir wichtig und du arbeitest gerne im Team. Du bist proaktiv unterwegs, arbeitest selbstorganisiert und bist entscheidungsfreudig. Gerne nutzt du deinen Handlungsspielraum. Dabei bist du durchsetzungsstark mit einer ausgeprägten Fähigkeit, integrierend zu wirken. Auch unter Druck bleibst du ruhig und setzt die richtigen Prioritäten.
* In komplexe Fragestellungen arbeitest du dich rasch ein, kannst in möglichen Lösungsvarianten denken und bist in der Lage, eine Gesamtsicht zu erlangen.
* In einem dynamischen Projektumfeld fällt es dir leicht, dich immer wieder an neue Rahmenbedingungen und externe Einflüsse anzupassen.
* Für diese anspruchsvolle Arbeit in der gesamtheitlichen Bauportfolioplanung bringst du mehrjährige Erfahrung im Infrastruktur-, Bahn-, Betriebs- oder Grossprojektumfeld mit, kennst die Zusammenhänge zwischen Eisenbahnbetrieb, Infrastruktur, Netzkapazität und Bautätigkeit und verfügst über einen Hochschul- oder Fachhochschulabschluss in einem relevanten Fachgebiet, z. B. Bauingenieurwesen, Verkehrswesen oder Infrastrukturmanagement.
* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf Niveau C2 sind ein Muss. Von Vorteil hast du Kenntnisse in einer zweiten Landessprache auf Niveau B1.

Ayoroa Simmons is seeking a Senior BIM/VDC Project Manager to lead model-based coordination and digital delivery across complex AEC projects, while supporting client relationships, strategic pursuits, and firm growth. BIM/VDC project leadership
Align BIM/VDC scope, schedule, budget, and staffing with overall project goals.
Lead BIM/VDC execution from pursuit and preconstruction through construction and closeout, including BIM Execution Plans, model coordination strategies, and deliverable schedules.

Serve as a trusted advisor, translating client goals into BIM/VDC scopes, work plans, and deliverables.
Manage assigned consultants and trade partners, including coordination of their scope, project invoicing, and billing.
Represent Ayoroa Simmons at industry events and conferences; partner with principals and marketing to align VDC capabilities with firm growth.

Evaluate and select BIM/VDC software, including Autodesk, Bluebeam, and comparable platforms, to advance leading industry workflows and production.
Drive innovation in Revit and coordination workflows, extending the firm's established leadership in scanning and reality capture; implement automation, dashboards, and emerging technologies (4D scheduling, digital twins, reality capture, prefabrication).
Train and mentor project teams on coordination processes, tools, and digital delivery expectations.
Team leadership & mentorship
Supervise, mentor, and develop BIM/VDC coordinators, specialists, and modelers.
Provide technical guidance to project managers, discipline leads, and field teams.
Foster a collaborative, solutions-oriented environment; promote knowledge sharing across projects and markets.

8+ years in BIM, VDC, construction technology, or digital project delivery, including 3+ years leading BIM/VDC on complex AEC projects.

Advanced proficiency with Revit, Navisworks, Autodesk Forma, and similar platforms.

**Responsable Département Projets & Service (fr-all)**
***Rejoignez ceux qui façonnent la mobilité de demain.***
Il y a des postes qui ressemblent à une étape. Et il y a des postes qui ressemblent à une mission.
Chez TSG, chaque station-service, chaque shop, chaque borne de recharge électrique raconte une histoire?: celle d-une Suisse qui avance, qui se transforme, qui choisit une mobilité plus propre, plus intelligente, plus humaine. **Votre rôle :**
En tant que **Responsable Département Projets & Service**, vous devenez le point d-équilibre entre nos équipes, nos clients, nos partenaires et notre vision. Votre mission est vaste, exigeante, passionnante :

* Vous soutenez nos techniciens en Suisse, véritables artisans de la mobilité du futur

* Vous entretenez et renforcez les relations commerciales, parce que la confiance est au cœur de nos valeurs
* Vous faites grandir les ventes de prestations de service**,** en apportant des solutions qui ont du sens
* Vous pilotez le budget du département Projets & Service, avec une vision claire et responsable
* Vous fluidifiez la communication entre les secteurs, pour que chaque projet avance comme une mécanique bien huilée
A terme, vous devenez une personne clé dans l-organisation de TSG sur le site de Givisiez. Un rôle qui ne se reçoit pas. Un rôle qui se mérite.
**Ce que vous apportez :**
Vous êtes une personne qui aime construire, fédérer, résoudre. Une personne qui sait que la technique n-a de valeur que lorsqu-elle sert l-humain. Une personne qui voit plus loin que son cahier de charges.

* Formation supérieure en gestion d-entreprise ou ingénierie (Bachelor, Master, MBA)
* Langue maternelle **française ou allemande**, **excellente maîtrise de l-autre langue** (italien = vrai atout)

* Capacité organisationnelle et compétences en gestion de projets, orientation solutions et service client

## Bereichsleitung Sozialberatung und Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung (80-100 %) ##
Gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Sozialberatung
Die Sozialberatung ist eines der zentralen Angebote von Pro Senectute Kanton Luzern. Rund 25 Mitarbeitende an den Standorten Luzern, Emmen und Willisau sowie bei der Infostelle Demenz beraten und begleiten ältere Menschen und ihre Angehörigen in unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen.
Als Bereichsleitung tragen Sie die personelle, fachliche und finanzielle Verantwortung für diesen wichtigen Bereich. Gleichzeitig sind Sie Teil unserer vierköpfigen Geschäftsleitung.
Ihre Aufgaben
* Sie führen den Bereich Sozialberatung und entwickeln ihn mit Blick auf gesellschaftliche Veränderungen und die zukünftigen Bedürfnisse älterer Menschen und ihrer Angehörigen gemeinsam mit den Mitarbeitenden weiter.
* Direkte Führung der Stellenleitenden der Beratungsstellen Emmen und Willisau, der Leitung Infostelle Demenz sowie des Teams Sozialberatung Luzern
* Sie verantworten Budget, Ressourcenplanung, Reporting und Zielerreichung des Bereichs.
* Sie stellen eine hohe fachliche Qualität sicher und fördern die Entwicklung der Mitarbeitenden.
* Sie übernehmen in einem begrenzten Umfang, ca. 10%, eigene Sozialberatungen und bleiben damit nahe an der Praxis und den Bedürfnissen unserer Klientel.
* Sie pflegen und entwickeln die Zusammenarbeit mit Gemeinden, Behörden und Fachorganisationen weiter und verantworten Leistungsvereinbarungen und Verträge.
* Als Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung tragen Sie Mitverantwortung für die Gesamtorganisation und wirken bei strategischen Fragestellungen, Organisationsentwicklungen und bereichsübergreifenden Projekten mit.
Das bringen Sie mit
* Einen Abschluss in Sozialer Arbeit auf Tertiärstufe oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
* Eine Weiterbildung in Führung, Management oder Organisationsentwicklung
* Mehrjährige Berufs- und Führungserfahrung, vorzugsweise im Sozial-, Gesundheits- oder Non-Profit-Bereich
* Freude, Menschen zu führen, Mitarbeitende zu entwickeln und gemeinsam Veränderungen zu gestalten
* Die Fähigkeit, fachliche, personelle und betriebswirtschaftliche Fragestellungen miteinander zu verbinden
* Strategisches und vernetztes Denken sowie ein gutes Verständnis für organisatorische und finanzielle Zusammenhänge
* Eine überzeugende Kommunikation und ein sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Mitarbeitenden, Behörden, Gemeinden und weiteren Partnerorganisationen
* Interesse an gesellschaftlichen und sozialpolitischen Fragestellungen rund um das Alter
* Eine selbständige, verantwortungsbewusste und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
Darauf können Sie sich freuen
Sie übernehmen eine vielseitige Führungsaufgabe mit Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum. Sie führen einen etablierten sowie fachlich starken Bereich und erhalten gleichzeitig die Möglichkeit, dessen zukünftige Ausrichtung aktiv mitzuprägen.
Als Mitglied der vierköpfigen Geschäftsleitung wirken Sie über Ihren eigenen Bereich hinaus und übernehmen Mitverantwortung an der operativen Entwicklung von Pro Senectute Kanton Luzern. Damit verbinden Sie operative Nähe mit strategischem Einfluss.
Sie bewegen sich in einem vielseitigen Umfeld an der Schnittstelle zwischen Sozialer Arbeit, Führung, Organisationsentwicklung und der Zusammenarbeit mit Gemeinden, Behörden und Fachorganisationen.
Ein engagiertes und kompetentes Team sowie ein unterstützendes Führungsteam erwartet Sie mit Freude. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit für mobil flexibles Arbeiten tragen unter anderem zu einem zeitgemässen Arbeitsumfeld bei. Wir unterstützen Ihre fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung und ermöglichen entsprechende Weiterbildungen. Ihr Arbeitsplatz befindet sich in Luzern.
Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung, inklusive Motivationsschreiben, an: bewerbung@lu.prosenectute.ch

Pour compléter son équipe, le Service des bâtiments et travaux, Unibat, est à la recherche d'une ingénieure ou d'un ingénieur représentant·e du maître de l'ouvrage.
Le service exploite une trentaine de bâtiments dédiés à l'enseignement et la recherche incluant notamment des laboratoires et une gestion centralisée de production et distribution des énergies.

Avec des infractructures vieillissantes, plusieurs objets classés au patrimoine et un cadre réglementaire en évolution, de nombreux projets d'envergure sont développés sur le campus, chacun disposant de son lot de spécificités techniques, énergétiques et organisationnelles.

un·e ingénieur·e représentant·e du maître de l'ouvrage

Professional registration or licensure -- Current registration as an Engineer Intern (EI), Engineer in Training (EIT)1, or licensure as a Professional Engineer (PE) by any State, the District of Columbia, Guam, or Puerto Rico.

Specified academic courses -- Successful completion of at least 60 semester hours of courses in the physical, mathematical, & engineering sciences & that included the courses specified in the basic requirements under paragraph A.
